title: C: regional registry masks and configuration bounds
description:
Add ordered/versioned channel-plan lookup beside lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/include/lichen/op_class.h and reconcile lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig, lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/Kconfig and affected public structures. Represent full global indices and canonical masks for 1..255 entries. The current 1..16 channel-count range cannot simply be widened while leaving unchecked frequency arithmetic or u32 wire masks. Unknown or unqualified plans must remain unusable.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse b7z9.23 intersection mechanics but not legacy bit order, u32 clipping or operating-class/plan conflation. A new registry source/header is proposed only as needed beside existing HAL code. Keep source, headers, Kconfig, CMake and corresponding test shims synchronized. No new registry framework, RF activation, identity/security change, SCHC replacement or key portability is required; custody stays best effort.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.03 through production C lookup/mask APIs with count, index, sparse-set, wrong-length and nonzero-padding boundaries, including independent 128-entry mask bytes and exact integer-Hz frequencies. Use focused host tests alongside lichen/tests/tdma_beacon and configuration/native compile checks. Run assertions, ASan/UBSan, conversion warnings and scoped C lint. lichen/west.yml currently pins v4.1.0; reverify at execution and qualify native_sim/native/64 on local Linux/heft against that pin, without hardware access.
